required_checks.assertion: Only the seven contract events may be dispatched.
Unknown or prohibited parameters reject the event.
Names, emails, phone numbers, form contents, and patient identifiers never reach analytics.
Prohibited, requires_review, unknown, and unclassified routes do not load analytics.
Events are not dispatched without the approved consent state.
Each logical event has exactly one collection owner.
Repeated field interaction and duplicate delivery do not create duplicate logical events.
form_submit, generate_lead, and appointment_request fire only at their defined success conditions.
